name: Paladin Oath of Vigilance (Paladin Oath)
body:
A paladin under the oath of vigilance has sworn to defend those under their care with utmost vigilance, be on guard for potential threats, drive back those who seek to cause harm to others, and bring swift victory.

Deity: A paladin with the oath of vigilance must follow and worship a deity that grants their clerics access to the guardian*, hero*, or protection domains (or the archon, cooperation, defense, heroism, or inevitable subdomains).

Watcher’s Awareness (Su)

A paladin with the oath of vigilance has undergone a targeted training program curated by the church to develop a different supernatural sense than most other paladins. This enables them to sense who within 60 feet of them is the most powerful creature (as determined by the creature’s Challenge Rating). This supernatural sense applies only to creatures within range that the oathbound paladin is aware of and can see. This does not confer knowledge of the creature’s CR or any other information (such as HD, type of creature, abilities, class, and so on).

If the creature with the highest CR within the range of watcher’s awareness has a CR that is 4+ higher than the oathbound paladin’s CR, then they are aware that such a creature is significantly more powerful than them.

This ability replaces detect evil.

Reposition Master (Su)

At 2nd level, an oathbound paladin focuses more on knocking back and defeating their enemies than utilizing positive energy. An oathbound paladin may add their Charisma modifier, up to a maximum of their paladin class level, to their CMB rolls and CMD when using or resisting any of the following combat maneuvers: bull rush, disarm, reposition, or trip. They also do not provoke attacks of opportunity when attempting these combat maneuvers normally.

At 5th level, an oathbound paladin is treated as if they are one size larger for their CMB rolls and CMD when using or resisting any of the combat maneuvers described above.

An oathbound paladin’s number of daily uses of lay on hands is reduced to their Charisma modifier.

This ability alters lay on hands.

Born Ready (Ex)

At 3rd level, through constant training, an oathbound paladin’s ability to lend aid to their allies has improved with a quicker reaction time.

An oathbound paladin can use the aid another action as a move action instead of as a standard action.

Additionally, an oathbound paladin can expend one daily use of lay on hands to instead perform an aid another action as a swift action.

However, the constant training and vigilance sacrifices a portion of the oathbound paladin’s spiritual strength, reducing their divine health from immunity to only a +1 sacred bonus to saving throws against all diseases (including magical diseases and mummy rot). This bonus increases by +1 every 5 levels thereafter.

This ability alters divine health.

Citadel Strength (Su)

At 4th level, an oathbound paladin forgoes traditional supernatural tradition to hone their ability to keep enemies at bay. As a swift action, an oathbound paladin can expend a daily use of their smite evil ability to instead gain the use of the Awesome Blow feat, without needing to meet its prerequisites, for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier, to a maximum of their class level.

They do not gain the benefits of reposition master to their awesome blow combat maneuver until 7th level.

This ability replaces channel energy.

Code of Conduct
Guard the weak and innocent from harm.
Maintain vigilance against the powerful, for power can corrupt the kindest heart.
Minimize the risks of danger to those under your watch.
Seek the most effective and swiftest path to ending conflict whenever possible.

Oath Spells: 1st—deathwatch; 2nd—see invisibility; 3rd—screech; 4th—mage’s faithful hound
